author: admin
title: Welcome to the new school year!
text:
Dear students, parents and colleagues,

a warm welcome to the 2026/2027 school year! This app is our new home for announcements, events and messages. Please log in, change your temporary password and check your groups.

Let's make it a great year!

author: admin
title: Heating maintenance: school closed on Friday
text: Because of urgent heating maintenance, the school building will be closed on Friday, 9 October. There are no lessons that day. The after-school club is also cancelled.

author: t_kovac
title: Bring an autumn leaf on Monday
text:
Hello 1A!

On Monday we start our leaf-art project. Please bring the most beautiful autumn leaf you can find on your way to school. Big, small, red or yellow, every leaf is welcome!

author: t_novak
title: Parent-teacher meetings: book your time slot
text:
Dear parents,

parent-teacher meetings take place on Thursday, 12 November, 15:00 to 19:00. Each meeting takes 10 minutes. Please reply with your preferred time and I will confirm it.

author: t_horvath
title: Bake sale for the class trip
text:
Class 2B is raising money for our spring trip to the zoo!

  • When: Wednesday, 28 October, during the long break
  • Where: school hall
  • Prices: 0.50 to 2 euros

Bakers, please bring your cakes to the classroom in the morning.

author: t_horvath
title: Great job on the maths test
text: Adam, I just wanted to say: your maths test was excellent, full marks! Keep up the good work.

author: t_balaz
title: Science fair: volcano projects due 6 November
text:
Young scientists of 3C,

your volcano projects are due on Friday, 6 November. Remember:

  • work in pairs
  • a poster that explains how a volcano erupts
  • baking soda and vinegar only, please, no real lava!

author: t_balaz
title: Volunteers needed for the museum trip
text:
Dear parents,

on 20 November Class 3C visits the Natural History Museum. We need two parent volunteers to help supervise the children. If you can join us, please let me know by 10 November.

author: zuzana_varga
title: Lost & found: blue lunchbox
text:
Hi everyone,

my daughter Sofia found a blue lunchbox with a dinosaur sticker in the cloakroom. If it belongs to your child, it is waiting with Mr. Kovac in classroom 1A.

author: t_novak
title: Reading challenge: 10 books before winter break
text:
Can you read 10 books before winter break? Every finished book gets a star on the reading wall. Everyone who reaches 10 stars gets a certificate and a surprise!

Comics count too. Happy reading!
